description: This Java class implements a cache for transport resources in the Thingsboard platform, managing resource retrieval, update, and eviction with thread safety and integration with transport service.

classes.name: DefaultTransportResourceCache
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe cache for transport resources, supporting get, update, and evict operations.

classes.name: ResourceCompositeKey
classes.description: A composite key class for identifying resources uniquely by tenant, resource type, and resource key, with a method to get a system tenant key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a resource from cache or fetches it if not present.

methods.name: fetchResource
methods.description: Fetches a resource from the transport service and updates the cache.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cache with the latest resource data.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a resource from the cache.
